name: fluctuating wind
definition_zh: 风相对于平均分量的随机波动部分。
usage_note: 若原文讨论速度，使用 fluctuating wind velocity 对应“脉动风速”；不把 fluctuating wind 与 gust 自动互换。
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道系统的随机动力分析中，风速随时间随机变化的成分用于计算抖振荷载，将风的随机波动作为系统激励纳入分析。

complete_examples.text: Based on the velocity spectrum of fluctuating wind of a moving vehicle, denoted by Suu(n), the following steps can be followed to simulate the fluctuating wind velocity ̃u(t): (1) Confirm the sampling number Nr at frequency domain n, where Nr is determined by the time scale of the fluctuating winds tu through the equation: Nr = tu/(1/nu), and Suu(n) is consequently interpolated into a new sequence with Nr discrete values.

Ignoring the high-order components of the fluctuating winds, the quasi-steady wind forces can be divided into two parts: the steady-state forces caused by the average wind speed U and the buffering forces caused by the unsteady wind velocity or the fluctuating wind The steady-state forces acting on the car body of the vehicle can be divided into three components in general, that is, side force, lift force and rolling moment, as defined in Equation (21), respectively.
